versions.changelog:
Initial release of indicator-lab.

- Backtests 13 technical indicators on SPY and QQQ using 5-year daily data.
- Supports momentum, trend, volatility, and volume indicators.
- Measures single, double, and triple indicator combinations.
- Ranks results by Sharpe, return, and max drawdown.
- Provides Buy & Hold baseline comparison.
- Command-line script for quick use; simple installation requirements.
